    ELECTRICAL RELIABILITY

    Preventive Maintenance

    Plan recurring machine maintenance, calculate the next due date automatically, track days left and control due reminders.

    ID Machine / Equipment Scope / Notes Location Responsible Interval Last PM Next PM Status Action
    Reminder logic: 2 days before → reminder · 1 day before → reminder · due date → urgent · overdue → stays urgent until Done. Pending pauses reminders for maximum 5 days and can be used only twice per maintenance cycle.

    Complete Preventive Maintenance

    Record the actual completion date. The next preventive date will be calculated automatically.

    Put Preventive Maintenance Pending

    Pending temporarily pauses reminders without changing the real next preventive date.

    Preventive Maintenance History

    Maintenance and pending history.

    JOB MATERIAL FLOW

    Item Requests

    ITEM REQUEST DETAIL

    New Item Request

    Controlled workflow: items must already exist in Store Inventory. Store Keeper prepares/reserves available quantity first; Inventory is not reduced at preparation. Admin or Super Admin final approval creates the exact Stock-out. Shortages remain pending and can be linked to Purchase Request. The requester confirms only what was actually received.

    Manage Users

    Super Admin workspace for account creation, access levels, Employee Master links, password resets and permission exceptions.

    Sensitive controls require Owner password re-verification and automatically relock after 5 minutes.
